blogs.title: LongRoPE Unpacked: The Road to Millions‑Token Context
blogs.description: Discover why LLMs need vastly larger memory than their default few thousand tokens and how LongRoPE pushes the boundary all the way to over 2 million tokens with just minimal fine‑tuning steps.

blogs.title: Beyond Flat Interpolation – Finding Non‑Uniform Patterns in RoPE
blogs.description: Learn what rotary positional embeddings (RoPE) are, why simple linear rescaling fails beyond an 8× extension, and how LongRoPE’s two–fold discovery—different scaling per dimension and per position—keeps crucial signals intact.

blogs.title: Evolutionary Search Meets Transformer Positional Embedding
blogs.description: See how an evolutionary algorithm scans billions of possible scaling combinations, uses prior methods as seeds, applies a monotonic constraint across dimensions, and pinpoints optimal rescale factors that make gigantic context windows feasible.

blogs.title: Scaling Gradually—From LLaMA2’s Default to a 2 M Token Powerhouse
blogs.description: Explore LongRoPE’s progressive strategy that first extends a model to 256 k tokens via guided search and lightweight fine‑tuning, then thrives another round of targeted interpolation—all without expensive full‑scale training.

blogs.title: Retaining Short‑Term Performance While Adding Long‑Term Memory
blogs.description: Understand how adding enormously many new positions can crowd early tokens and hurt classic tasks, and how LongRoPE rebuilds positional weights for short contexts via a secondary search run during inference.

blogs.title: From Passkeys to Big Summaries – Real‑World Impact of 2 M Token Contexts
blogs.description: See concrete use cases like robust passkey retrieval over million‐token passages and envision how such long horizons will unlock richer document understanding, multi-hop reasoning, and more powerful LLM agents.
